verdict.rationale: Kushki has first-party refund docs: a 'Returns, cancellations, and refunds' page in English and a 'Devoluciones, anulaciones y reembolsos' page in Spanish, both under the card-payments refunds section. Only the page titles are in evidence, so the specific elements of the story are unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of partial versus full refund amounts, evidence of issuing refunds from the dashboard, evidence of a refund API endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can issue full or partial refunds from both the dashboard and the API
